blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent single-stage 3D generative models commonly adopt VecSet representations, encoding 3D shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens.
However, compared with two-stage methods that provide explicit positional guidance, these models must implicitly infer token positions throughout denoising, limiting their generation quality.
We observe that, despite the absence of explicit positional conditioning, VecSet tokens retain recoverable spatial correspondences.
Building on this observation, we propose Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework. During denoising, Position Forcing recovers token positions from the current clean latent estimate, quantizes them at progressively finer resolutions according to the denoising stage, and feeds the resulting positional encodings back into the diffusion Transformer.
This progressively refined positional feedback provides spatial guidance at a granularity appropriate to each denoising stage, guiding shape generation along a coarse-to-fine trajectory and substantially improving generation quality without a separate position generation stage.
Experiments demonstrate that Position Forcing achieves strong performance among single-stage 3D generative methods and outperforms several competitive multi-stage approaches.
blocks.zh:
最近的单相3D基因模型通常采用VecSet表示法,将3D外形编码为无序的一组潜入物.
然而,与提供明确定位指导的两阶段方法相比,这些模型必须暗地里推导出自吹自擂的象征性位置,限制其生成质量。
我们注意到,尽管没有明确的定位条件,但VecSet信使仍保留可收回的空间通信。
基于这一看法,我们提出立场强化,一个基于立场的自理框架。 在去Noing时,Palace Forcing会从目前的清洁潜在估计中恢复象征性位置,按照去Noing阶段的更精细分辨率对其进行量化,并将由此产生的位置编码反馈到扩散变形器中。
这种逐渐完善的位置反馈在适合每个去诺阶段的颗粒度上提供了空间取向,引导外形的生成沿着粗细到细的轨迹进行,并在没有单独的位置生成阶段的情况下大幅度地提高生成质量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
3D content is a fundamental component of the digital world, supporting a wide range of applications in gaming, filmmaking, and virtual reality [ Xu et al., 2024 , Wang et al., 2026c , Gong et al., 2026 ] .
However, creating high-quality 3D assets typically requires specialized modeling expertise and substantial manual effort, making it difficult to meet the growing demand for 3D content.
Recent advances in generative models have enabled the automatic synthesis of high-quality 3D assets conditioned on images or text, offering new opportunities to make 3D creation more accessible and efficient.
In particular, diffusion- and flow-based generative models [ Ho et al., 2020 , Rombach et al., 2022 , Lipman et al., 2023 , Peebles and Xie, 2023 , Ma et al., 2024 , Wang et al., 2026a , Zhou et al., 2025 , Ouyang et al., 2026 ] have been widely adopted for 3D geometry generation, substantially improving generation quality and practical usability [ Zhao et al., 2023 , Zhao et al., 2025 , Li et al., 2025b , Wang et al., 2026b ] .
blocks.zh:
3D内容是数字世界的一个基本组成部分,支持游戏,电影制作,虚拟现实等广泛的应用[來源請求]. 徐等,2024年;王等,2026c;龚等,2026年] (中文(简体) ).
然而,创造高质量的三维资产通常需要专业的建模专门知识和大量的人工努力,因此难以满足日益增长的三维内容需求.
最近基因模型的进步,使得以图像或文字为条件的高质量三维资产能够自动合成,提供了使三维创建更加方便和高效的新机会.
特别是,基于传播和流动的基因模型[ Ho等, 2020., Rombach等, 2022., Lipman等, 2023. Peebles and Xie, 2023., Ma等, 2024. Wang等, 2026a., 周等, 2025., Ouyang等, 2026)被广泛采用为3D几何代,大大提高了生成质量和实用性[. 赵等,2023年;赵等,2025年;李等,2025年b;王等,2026年b)].

blocks.en:
To efficiently model complex 3D geometry, recent 3D generative methods widely adopt VecSet-style representations, which compress shapes into a compact set of latent tokens and enable generative modeling in an efficient latent space [ Zhang et al., 2023 , Zhao et al., 2023 , Li et al., 2024 , Zhao et al., 2025 ] .
During generation, however, the model starts from a set of unordered noise tokens.
Without explicit positional guidance, the model must establish both the spatial organization of the tokens and their corresponding geometric representations within a single denoising process, making generative modeling more challenging.
blocks.zh:
为了高效地模拟复杂的3D几何,最近的3D基因方法广泛采用VecSet风格的表示法,将它压缩成一组紧凑的潜入物,并能够在高效潜入地空间进行基因模型制作[张等,2023年;赵等,2023年;李等,2024年;赵等,2025年].
然而,在生成过程中,模型从一组无序噪声符号开始.
在没有明确定位指导的情况下,模型必须在单一去诺化过程中既确定符的空间组织,又确定相应的几何表示,使基因模型更具挑战性.

blocks.en:
To alleviate this difficulty, recent methods adopt multi-stage generation paradigms and achieve substantial improvements in generation quality [ Xiang et al., 2025 , Lai et al., 2026 , Xiang et al., 2026 ] .
These methods typically first generate a coarse spatial structure to explicitly determine where geometric content should reside, and then use this structure to guide fine-grained geometry generation.
This explicit spatial guidance facilitates subsequent geometry
modeling but relies on a separate structure-generation model
and an additional sampling stage.
We therefore seek to obtain explicit spatial guidance directly within a single-stage generation process, without introducing an additional structure-generation stage.
blocks.zh:
为了缓解这一困难,最近的方法采用了多阶段发电模式,并大幅度地改进了发电质量[ Xiang等,2025年;Lai等,2026年;Xiang等,2026年] (中文(简体) ).
这些方法通常首先产生粗细的空间结构来明确确定应存在几何含量的位置,再用这种结构来指导细纹几何生成.
这种清晰的空间取向有利于后续几何
建模但依赖于单独的结构生成模型
和额外的取样阶段。
因此,我们力求在单一阶段的生成过程中直接获得明确的空间指导,而不引入额外的结构生成阶段。

Figure 1 : Our observation and positional conditioning designs. (I) Latents can be decoded into shape geometry and token positions. (II) (a) VecSet uses no explicit positional conditioning; (b) VoxSet and two-stage pipelines use positions established beforehand.
(c) Our naive design recovers positions from the current noisy state.

图1:我们的观察和位置调节设计。 (一)Latents可以被解码为形状几何和符号位置. (二) (a) VecSet没有使用明确的定位装置;(b) VoxSet和两相管线使用事先确定的定位装置。
(c) 我们的天真设计从目前吵闹状态中恢复了位置。
(d) 定位强化从预测的清洁状态中恢复位置,并采用渐进式量化方法提供粗细至细的空间指导。

blocks.en:
To this end, we further investigate the spatial properties of VecSet latent representations.
In a VecSet VAE with point queries, each latent token is constructed from a corresponding spatial query and is therefore associated with a query position.
We observe that this positional correspondence is retained in the encoded latent representation.
As shown in Fig. 1 (I), the corresponding query positions can be recovered from the latent tokens alone, indicating that the unordered VecSet representation retains decodable spatial information.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们进一步调查VecSet潜在表示的空间特性。
在带有点查询的VecSet VAE中,每个潜在符符由相应的空间查询来构建,因此与查询位置相关.
我们注意到,这种立场通信被保留在编码的潜在代表中。
如图一(一)所示,仅从潜入的符号中即可取回相应的查询位置,表明无序VecSet代表保留可解码的空间信息.

blocks.en:
Since this positional information can be recovered from latent tokens, a natural idea is to feed the recovered positions back into the model as explicit spatial conditioning during generation.
To this end, we first consider a naive design that predicts token positions from the current noisy latent during both training and inference and constructs positional encodings at full spatial resolution, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (II)(c).
However, we find that this direct approach often produces shapes with incorrect geometry.
At high noise levels, position predictions are unreliable, and full-resolution positional encodings can make the model rely on incorrect fine-grained spatial relationships.
blocks.zh:
由于这种位置信息可以从潜在的活物中取出,一个自然的想法是将被取回的位置反馈到模型中,作为生成时的清晰空间调节.
为此,我们首先考虑一种天真的设计,在培训和推论期间从当前噪音潜伏中预测象征性位置,并以完全空间分辨率构建位置编码,如图1(II)(c)所示。
然而,我们发现,这种直接方法往往会产生形状,其几何形状不正确。
在高噪量下,位置预测不可靠,全分辨率位置编码可以使模型依赖于不正确的细纹空间关系.

blocks.en:
Building on these observations, we propose Position Forcing , a position-based self-conditioning framework that provides spatial guidance through progressively refined positional feedback.
We first introduce a progressive position quantization strategy governed by the noise level, matching the granularity of spatial conditioning to the current generation step.
At high noise levels, we quantize positions onto a coarse spatial grid to preserve global layout information while reducing sensitivity to positional errors.
As the noise level decreases, we progressively increase the quantization resolution, refining positional guidance from global layout to local spatial relationships.
blocks.zh:
在这些意见的基础上,我们提议“定位强化”这一基于定位的自我调节框架,通过逐步完善的位置反馈提供空间指导。
我们首先引入了由噪声水平调节的渐进式位置量化策略,将空间调节的颗粒性与现在的生成步骤相匹配.
在高噪音水平上,我们把位置量化到粗糙的空间网格上,以保存全球布局信息,同时降低对位置错误的敏感性.
随着噪声水平的降低,我们逐渐地提高分数分辨率,完善了从全球布局到地方空间关系的定位取向.

blocks.en:
To further reduce the impact of noise on position recovery and provide more accurate positional guidance, we consider recovering token positions from the predicted clean latent representation.
Specifically, during inference, we use the model-predicted velocity field to compute the predicted clean latent, recover token positions from it, and progressively quantize them, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (II)(d).
These positional conditions are fed back into the diffusion Transformer through RoPE, providing coarse-to-fine spatial guidance for subsequent denoising.
To further improve generation quality, we train the model with accurate query positions using the same quantization.
Together, these designs enable Position Forcing to continually update spatial guidance within a single denoising trajectory, guiding generation from global layout to fine-grained local geometry without a separate position generation stage.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步减少噪音对位置恢复的影响并提供更准确的位置指导,我们考虑从预测的清洁潜在代表物中恢复象征性位置。
具体地说,在推论中,我们使用模型预想的速度场来计算预测的清洁潜伏,从中取回象征性位置并逐渐地将其数量化,如图1(II)(d)所示。
这些位置条件通过RoPE反馈回扩散变形器,为后起去诺提供粗细至细的空间指导.
为了进一步提高生成质量,我们使用相同的量化法,对模型进行精确的查询位置的培训.
这些设计共同使"位置强化"能够在单一去诺化轨迹内不断更新空间指向,引导一代人从全球布局到精细的局部几何,而不另设位置生成阶段.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , our framework comprises two main components: Position VAE and Position-Forced DiT.
Position VAE augments the geometry decoder with a position decoder that recovers the spatial positions associated with latent tokens.
During denoising, Position-Forced DiT uses this position decoder to recover positions from the current clean latent estimate. These positions are quantized at progressively finer resolutions as the noise level decreases and fed back into the DiT through RoPE, providing coarse-to-fine spatial guidance for single-stage 3D generation.

VAE位置用一个位置解码器来增强几何分解码器,可以恢复与潜在符相相关的空间位置.
在去诺时,位置强制DiT使用此位置解码器从当前干净的潜在估计中取回位置. 随着噪声水平的降低,这些位置以更细的分辨率被量化,并通过ROPE反馈回DiT,为单相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en:
Conventional point-query VecSet VAEs encode an input geometry
into a compact set of latent tokens using spatial queries sampled
from the object surface.
LATTICE [ Lai et al., 2026 ] then introduces VoxSet by replacing point
queries with voxel queries located at the centers of active voxels,
thereby anchoring latent tokens to a coarse spatial grid.
To accommodate voxel queries at different spatial resolutions,
LATTICE perturbs the surface queries selected by farthest point
sampling (FPS) before encoding: 𝐩 i = 𝐩 i FPS + 𝜹 i , 𝜹 i ∼ 𝒰 ​ [ − 1 2 ​ R , 1 2 ​ R ] 3 , \mathbf{p}_{i}=\mathbf{p}_{i}^{\mathrm{FPS}}+\bm{\delta}_{i},\qquad\bm{\delta}_{i}\sim\mathcal{U}\left[-\frac{1}{2R},\frac{1}{2R}\right]^{3}, (1) where R R denotes the spatial resolution and 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} is the query position supplied to the encoder.
The encoder produces latent tokens associated with these queries
through cross-attention with the input point cloud followed by
self-attention.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning
framework for single-stage 3D generation.
Our key observation is that VecSet latents retain
correspondences with their spatial queries, enabling positional guidance
to be recovered directly from geometry latents.
Position VAE enables position recovery from geometry latents, while
Position-Forced DiT uses the recovered positions as spatial guidance
during denoising.
Experiments demonstrate competitive performance against both
single-stage and multi-stage methods.

During training, we quantize the query positions associated
with the frozen VAE encoder to provide spatial guidance
to the DiT.
During inference, positions recovered from the predicted
clean latents are quantized at the next step’s resolution
to condition subsequent denoising.
Here, rope_idx denotes the quantized coordinates
used to construct 3D RoPE within the DiT.
For clarity, the pseudocode omits training-time positional
perturbations and image-condition dropout.
